name: vwap_pivot_rejection_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the session VWAP drifts within 25 spot points of a daily pivot level (S1, PP, or R1 computed from previous day's H/L/C), two independent algorithmic order clusters concentrate at the same price region — VWAP-benchmarked futures algorithms defending their average fill cost and pivot-level conditional order queues (stop-clusters and entry triggers built around round-number pivot math). A 30-second price test into this double-friction zone followed by a dominant directional wick (close ending in the opposite direction from the test, 55%+ of 30s range as the rejection wick) signals institutional absorption held: both VWAP defenders and pivot algo buyers/sellers absorbed supply/demand and the zone validated. The next 45-90 seconds typically see 15-25 NIFTY spot points of follow-through as momentum algorithms confirm the zone defended and pile in.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP within 25 points of daily pivot (S1/PP/R1) with 30-second rejection wick dominant in opposite direction (55%+ of range), confirming double-friction zone defense
